message.content: Tracy Jensen, the recommended candidate for Alameda's at-large mayor, has a mixed documented record on the issue. The CAIR-SFBA tracker lists her as having supported a ceasefire letter in January 2024. In a questionnaire response of unstated date, she opposed a later Gaza ceasefire letter as ineffective and divisive, explaining that she worked on eliminating investments in all weapons rather than pursuing an Israel-specific BDS policy. Her campaign platform calls for restricting municipal investments in guns and carbon fuels. She received a general-election endorsement from the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, a county Democratic organization whose stated mission includes supporting Israel as a democratic, inclusive, and secure Jewish state; the record assigns this endorsement low contextual weight, noting it does not establish agreement with every club policy.
